function.name: promptcrew
function.description: Record and retrieve project-scoped visible prompts, employee roles, task branches and versioned outputs in PromptCrew. Dispatch arguments through PromptCrew.Tools; credentials come from the host, never tool arguments. Body schemas and required IDs are documented in docs/promptcrew-api.md and the running OpenAPI endpoint.

roundId.description: For get_context: the chosen parent; omit for a new root.

leftVersion.description: Optional output version of roundId for compare_rounds; omitted selects latest.

rightVersion.description: Optional output version of otherRoundId. Use the same round IDs to compare its output history.

clientRequestId.description: Only for get_by_request. For writes put clientRequestId inside body.

body.description: The exact API input. save_round and save_result require a fresh UUID clientRequestId, retained with this entire request for retries. Updates and save_result require expectedVersion.
